![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14040587/assets/d52d7a1e64de7618d5c9253ee00eafc43462e8a40e52fa7da671ef1f5a094e68.png)

What is the polar equation of the ray shown above?
worked_solution:
The counterclockwise angle that the ray makes with the positive $x$-axis is

$$
\pi -\frac{8\pi }{15}=\frac{7\pi }{15}.
$$

Therefore, the polar equation of the ray is $\theta =\frac{7\pi }{15}.$
